FamilyMart plans TX GHOST and smart-shelf rollout from January 2027

Drink-restocking robots work with digital inventory shelves; pilot stores reported roughly 70% less work in the targeted task.

FamilyMart ↗19 November 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 3Videos 1

The new development

FamilyMart announced on November 19 that it will begin progressively introducing TX GHOST drink-restocking robots and digital inventory shelves in January 2027. Development and trials with Telexistence began in 2020. The expansion targets cooler-related work, rather than describing stores that operate without staff.

Technology and applications

The company says the robot can replenish sales shelves around the clock, handling up to approximately 1,800 bottles per day and prioritizing products using sales data. Smart Shelf starts tracking item locations and quantities when the first item is scanned, supports mixed stock and suggests replenishment quantities.

Scope and next steps

Early stores reported roughly a 70% reduction in the targeted inventory and restocking workload. Employees still load goods onto Smart Shelf, so the figure is not a reduction in all store labour. The announcement does not specify a final store count, system price or nationwide completion date.
